_note: Plain-words copy for the downloadable sector guides (SectorGuidePdf). The facts about each trade come from sectors.json and subsectors.json; this file holds only the wording that is the same for every trade. {items}, {orders}, {customer}, {staff}, {location} are replaced with that trade's own words; add |lower for mid-sentence.
intro: Busynez is one system for running a business in Kenya: the till, the stock, the people who work for you and the money at the end of the day.
It is made by LeziTech in Mombasa. It runs on a phone, a tablet or a computer, and the till keeps working when the internet drops.
This guide is about your trade only. Keep it on your phone and read it when you are free.
screensIntro: You are not given screens you will never use. A business like yours starts with these:
wordsIntro: The system speaks your trade. On your screens you will see:
numbersIntro: The first screen every morning shows the few numbers that matter to a business like yours:
switchesIntro: These come with your kind of business. Any of them can be left off if you do not want it:
start: Open busynez.site on your phone and press Start free. There is nothing to pay and no card to give.
Say what kind of business you run, and tick the things you will use. We do not ask for prices, and a KRA PIN is optional - leave it out if you like.
Put in your business name, your till or paybill number, and your logo if you have one. Your receipts and emails then carry your own name.
Add what you sell. Type it in, or send us your Excel list - with photos if you have them - and we will load it for you.
Add the people who work for you. Each gets their own sign-in and sees only their own screens.
Start selling. Nothing else needs to be finished first.
effort: Setting up: about half an hour on your own, or send us your list and we do it for you.
Teaching a new person the till: a few minutes. They see one screen, not the whole system.
Your own time each day: a look at the first screen in the morning, and a few minutes at closing.
What you need: a phone or a cheap tablet, and the same internet you already use. The till keeps selling when the network goes down and catches up after.
What you can stop doing: counting from a notebook, asking staff what was sold, and guessing what is finished in the store.
comingSoon: This part of Busynez is not open yet, and we would rather say so than sell you something that is not ready.
It is being built. Everything in this guide is what it will do.

Tell us you want it and we will let you know the day it opens - no cost, and no salesman calling you every week. Open busynez.site, choose your trade and press Tell me when it is ready, or send us a WhatsApp.
closing: If anything in here is not clear, ask us. A real person in Mombasa answers.

dashboard.label: Home
dashboard.what: The first screen. Today's money, and whatever needs you to do something about it.

floor.label: Tables
floor.what: Your tables on one screen: who is seated, what they have ordered and what they owe.

pos.label: Till
pos.what: Where you sell. Find the {item|lower}, take M-Pesa or cash, and the receipt goes out.

kitchen.label: Kitchen screen
kitchen.what: Orders reach the cooks the moment the {staff|lower} sends them. No shouting, no lost chits.

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.what: Who is in tonight, who arrives, who leaves, and which rooms still need cleaning.

bookings.label: Bookings
bookings.what: The diary. Who booked, for when, and with whom.

trips.label: Trips
trips.what: Departures, seats still free, and who has paid a deposit.

property.label: Rent and tenants
property.what: Every unit, who is in it, the rent bills, and who is behind.

meters.label: Meter readings
meters.what: Water and power readings, put straight onto the tenant's bill.

jobs.label: Repair jobs
jobs.what: What is broken, who is fixing it, and whether it is finished.

market.label: Collection round
market.what: The day's collection: who was visited, who paid, and who was not in.

items.label: {items}
items.what: Everything you sell, with its price and its photo.

stock.label: Stock
stock.what: What you have, what is running low, and what moved from one {location|lower} to the next.

purchasing.label: Buying stock
purchasing.what: What you ordered from suppliers, what arrived, and what it really cost you.

sales.label: {orders}
sales.what: Every sale you have made, paid or not, with its receipt.

customers.label: {customers}
customers.what: Who they are, what they have had from you, and who still has to pay you.

crm.label: Sales leads
crm.what: People who asked about you, and when to follow them up.

quotes.label: Price quotes
quotes.what: Send a price today, turn it into a sale when they agree.

reports.label: Reports

settings.label: Settings
settings.what: Your name, logo, till number, prices and all the switches.

kpis.open_quotes: Price quotes waiting for an answer

features.tables: Tables, with a bill that stays with the table until they leave.
features.kitchen: A kitchen screen, so orders reach the cooks by themselves.
features.courses: Starters, mains and drinks sent to the kitchen in order.
features.splitBill: Split a bill: pay together, or one person at a time.
features.barcode: Barcode scanning, if your goods carry barcodes.
features.expiry: Expiry dates watched, so you are warned before stock goes bad.
features.prescriptions: A prescription prompt at the till.
features.wholesalePricing: Different prices for big buyers and small buyers.
features.credit: {customers} who pay later, with a limit and a statement.
features.catering: Catering orders for events and offices: the menu, a deposit, and the balance to pay.
features.appointments: Online bookings, with free times shown per {staff|lower}.
features.commissions: Each {staff|lower}'s share worked out for you.
features.storeFeedsShops: A store that supplies your shops, with transfers recorded.
features.rooms: Rooms, check-in and check-out, with the bill settled at the end.
features.trips: Trips with dates, seats and deposits.
features.property: Units, tenants and rent bills made every month.
features.deposits: Deposits taken up front and held against the bill.
features.orderBoard: A screen or TV showing which orders are ready.
features.publicMenu: Your own page online, where people see your {items|lower} and order.
features.allowNegativeStock: Selling is never blocked because the stock count is behind.
